Built on Windows with the Android NDK r28c (android-ndk-r28c-windows.zip from dl.google.com):

    <ndk>/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android35-clang.cmd -O2 -o threads threads.c
    <ndk>/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android35-clang.cmd -O2 -o thread_exit thread_exit.c

    <ndk>/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android35-clang.cmd -O2 -o signals signals.c
    <ndk>/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android35-clang.cmd -O2 -o faults faults.c

    <ndk>/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/aarch64-linux-android35-clang.cmd -O2 -o gralloc gralloc.c -lnativewindow

The binaries are committed so the runtime and its tests never need the NDK; SHA256SUMS pins them.

dex/hello.dex, from dex/Hello.java with JDK 21 and SDK build-tools 36.0.0:

    javac --release 8 Hello.java
    d8 --min-api 26 --output . Hello.class      (classes.dex, renamed hello.dex)
